description: {{DESCRIPTION}} POST /v1/signals with a small JSON body for ranked, scored, cited signals; /v1/signal {series_id} for one; /v1/explain for why it moved. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Options for POST /v1/signals (other routes take similar small bodies).

sort.description: composite, change, abs_change, confidence or deviation.

outputSchema.description: For POST /v1/signals, {service, horizon, sort, count, signals[]}; each signal has summary, value, changes_pct, zscore, percentile, composite_score, trend, risk_flags, confidence, provenance (citation_url, source, fetch_time, raw_sha256). Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).

responseSummary.note: Fill from a live MainNet capture.
